title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二章、绑匪的画

    八王爷被人绑架了，王府总管福康着急地哭了，皇帝让他不要哭了，把事情好好和包拯说一说。
    福康马上擦了把眼泪，站起身说：“王爷喜欢游山玩水，已经有大半年没在府里住了，前天晚上才从望山回来。王爷本来准备昨天进宫去见皇上的，但早上收到一封信，看完信王爷就说要去城外的南湖亭，说是要去见一位老朋友。王爷早饭都没吃，换了衣服就去了。中午下雪了，我担心王爷冷，就拿了厚衣服给王爷送过去，可是到了南湖亭却没有看到王爷和朋友。问了岸边的船家，才知道昨天根本没有人在亭里游玩。我急坏了，马上回来叫府里的人去找王爷。刚好那时候张公公来府里，他听说这件事以后就马上回去告诉皇上了。”
    皇帝叹了口气说：“张怀将此事告诉我后，我马上让卫宁去找了，但找了一整晚也没有找到。我本以为王爷是和朋友玩得高兴，忘了回家，但没想到早上就见到了这件血衣。”
    “写信来请王爷去南湖亭的那位朋友是谁？去他家找过了吗？”包拯问。
    “没有人知道这位朋友是谁，送信来的人是个孩子。卫宁找到了这个孩子，但孩子的眼睛不好，看不见东西。孩子说有人给了他一颗糖，让他把信送到王府。他不知道让他送信的人长什么样子，只知道是个女人，而他送给王爷的那封信——”皇帝看了看张怀，张怀马上将一张纸送到了包拯面前，“其实不是信，而是一幅画。”皇帝停了一下，再说：“画的是一个普通食盒，没有任何特别的地方。”
    包拯把纸打开。画里一个黑色的食盒，有提手和盖子，但里面没有装东西，食盒是空的。盒盖右边写了“南湖亭”三个小字。
    “有人送了这幅画给王爷，然后王爷就出门了。王爷出门是因为画里的食盒，还是‘南湖亭’这三个字呢？”包拯的问题是问王府总管福康的。
    福康想了想，说：“以前没听王爷说过南湖亭，他也没去过这个地方。昨天他说要去南湖亭的时候，也没有问我们这个地方怎么样，就是急着要出门去见朋友的样子。”
    包拯点头：“那就是因为画里的食盒了。这个食盒一定有特别的地方，我们没有认出来，但王爷认出来了。王府里有这样的食盒吗？可以拿给我看看吗？”
    “有，有！”福康马上让人去拿食盒。
fullText.traditional:
第二章、綁匪的畫

    八王爺被人綁架了，王府總管福康著急地哭了，皇帝讓他不要哭了，把事情好好和包拯說一說。
    福康馬上擦了把眼淚，站起身說：“王爺喜歡遊山玩水，已經有大半年沒在府裡住了，前天晚上才從望山回來。王爺本來準備昨天進宮去見皇上的，但早上收到一封信，看完信王爺就說要去城外的南湖亭，說是要去見一位老朋友。王爺早飯都沒吃，換了衣服就去了。中午下雪了，我擔心王爺冷，就拿了厚衣服給王爺送過去，可是到了南湖亭卻沒有看到王爺和朋友。問了岸邊的船家，才知道昨天根本沒有人在亭裡遊玩。我急壞了，馬上回來叫府裡的人去找王爺。剛好那時候張公公來府裡，他聽說這件事以後就馬上回去告訴皇上了。”
    皇帝嘆了口氣說：“張懷將此事告訴我後，我馬上讓衛寧去找了，但找了一整晚也沒有找到。我本以為王爺是和朋友玩得高興，忘了回家，但沒想到早上就見到了這件血衣。”
    “寫信來請王爺去南湖亭的那位朋友是誰？去他家找過了嗎？”包拯問。
    “沒有人知道這位朋友是誰，送信來的人是個孩子。衛寧找到了這個孩子，但孩子的眼睛不好，看不見東西。孩子說有人給了他一顆糖，讓他把信送到王府。他不知道讓他送信的人長什麼樣子，只知道是個女人，而他送給王爺的那封信——”皇帝看了看張懷，張懷馬上將一張紙送到了包拯面前，“其實不是信，而是一幅畫。”皇帝停了一下，再說：“畫的是一個普通食盒，沒有任何特別的地方。”
    包拯把紙打開。畫裡一個黑色的食盒，有提手和蓋子，但裡面沒有裝東西，食盒是空的。盒蓋右邊寫了“南湖亭”三個小字。
    “有人送了這幅畫給王爺，然後王爺就出門了。王爺出門是因為畫裡的食盒，還是‘南湖亭’這三個字呢？”包拯的問題是問王府總管福康的。
    福康想了想，說：“以前沒聽王爺說過南湖亭，他也沒去過這個地方。昨天他說要去南湖亭的時候，也沒有問我們這個地方怎麼樣，就是急著要出門去見朋友的樣子。”
    包拯點頭：“那就是因為畫裡的食盒了。這個食盒一定有特別的地方，我們沒有認出來，但王爺認出來了。王府裡有這樣的食盒嗎？可以拿給我看看嗎？”
    “有，有！”福康馬上讓人去拿食盒。

sentences.pinyin: zuó tiān tā shuō yào qù nán hú tíng de shí hou yě méi yǒu wèn wǒ men zhè ge dì fang zěn me yàng
sentences.english: Yesterday when he said he was going to the South Lake Pavilion, he didn’t even ask us what this place was like.

sentences.simplified: 就是急着要出门去见朋友的样子。”
sentences.traditional: 就是急著要出門去見朋友的樣子。”
sentences.pinyin: jiù shì jí zhe yào chū mén qù jiàn péng you de yàng zi
sentences.english: He just seemed to be in a hurry to go out and meet his friend.”

sentences.simplified: 包拯点头：“那就是因为画里的食盒了。
sentences.traditional: 包拯點頭：“那就是因為畫裡的食盒了。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng diǎn tóu nà jiù shì yīn wèi huà lǐ de shí hé le
sentences.english: Bao Zheng nodded, “That’s because of the food box in the drawing.

sentences.simplified: 这个食盒一定有特别的地方，我们没有认出来，但王爷认出来了。
sentences.traditional: 這個食盒一定有特別的地方，我們沒有認出來，但王爺認出來了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shí hé yí dìng yǒu tè bié de dì fang wǒ men méi yǒu rèn chu lai dàn wáng ye rèn chu lai le
sentences.english: This food box must have something special about it that we didn’t recognize, but the prince did.

sentences.simplified: 王府里有这样的食盒吗？可以拿给我看看吗？”
sentences.traditional: 王府裡有這樣的食盒嗎？可以拿給我看看嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: wáng fǔ lǐ yǒu zhè yàng de shí hé ma kě yǐ ná gěi wǒ kàn kan ma
sentences.english: Does the prince’s mansion have this type of food box? Can you show it to me?”

sentences.simplified: “有，有！”福康马上让人去拿食盒。
sentences.traditional: “有，有！”福康馬上讓人去拿食盒。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yǒu fú kāng mǎ shàng ràng rén qù ná shí hé
sentences.english: “Yes, yes!” Fu Kang immediately sent someone to fetch the food boxes.

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: The Kidnapper’s Drawing
The Eighth Prince had been kidnapped, and the chief steward of the prince’s mansion, Fu Kang, was so anxious that he cried.
The emperor told him not to cry, and to explain the situation clearly to Bao Zheng.
Fu Kang immediately wiped away his tears, stood up, and said, ..
.. “The prince enjoys traveling and has not stayed in the prince’s mansion for more than half a year.
He just returned from Wangshan the night before last.
The prince originally planned to go to the palace to see the emperor yesterday, but he received a letter in the morning.
After reading the letter, the prince said he was going to the South Lake Pavilion outside the city, saying he would meet an old friend.
The prince didn’t even eat breakfast. He just changed his clothes and went.
It snowed at noon, and I was worried that the prince might be cold, so I took some thick clothes to him.
However, when I arrived at the South Lake Pavilion, I didn’t see the prince with his friend.
After asking the boatman by the shore, I found out that no one had been at the pavilion yesterday.
I was extremely anxious and immediately returned to tell the people at the mansion to go and look for the prince.
Just then, the eunuch Zhang came to the mansion. After hearing about this matter, he immediately went back to report it to the emperor.”
The emperor sighed and said, ..
.. “After Zhang Huai told me about this, I immediately sent Wei Ning to look for him, but he searched all night and couldn’t find him.
I initially thought the prince was having fun with his friend and forgot to come home.
I didn’t expect that I would see this bloodstained garment in the morning.”
“Who is the friend who wrote the letter inviting the prince to the South Lake Pavilion?
Have you gone to his house to look for him?” Bao Zheng asked.
“No one knows who this friend is. The letter was delivered by a child.
Wei Ning found the child, but the child’s eyes were not good and he couldn’t see anything.
The child said someone gave him a piece of candy and got him to deliver the letter to the prince’s mansion.
He didn’t know what the person who asked him to deliver the letter looked like.
He only knew it was a woman and that the letter he delivered to the prince—”
The emperor glanced at Zhang Huai, and Zhang Huai immediately handed a piece of paper to Bao Zheng, ..
.. “was not actually a letter, but a drawing.”
The emperor paused for a moment, then continued, “The drawing is of an ordinary food box. There’s nothing special about it.”
Bao Zheng unfolded the paper.
In the drawing, there was a black food box with a handle and a lid, but there was nothing inside. The food box was empty.
On the right side of the box lid, the three small characters “South Lake Pavilion” were written.
“Someone delivered this drawing to the prince, and then the prince went out.
Did the prince go out because of the food box in the drawing, or because of the three characters ‘South Lake Pavilion’?”
Bao Zheng’s question was directed at the chief steward of the prince’s mansion, Fu Kang.
Fu Kang thought for a moment and said, ..
.. “I’ve never heard the prince mention the South Lake Pavilion before, and he has never been to this place.
Yesterday when he said he was going to the South Lake Pavilion, he didn’t even ask us what this place was like.
He just seemed to be in a hurry to go out and meet his friend.”
Bao Zheng nodded, “That’s because of the food box in the drawing.
This food box must have something special about it that we didn’t recognize, but the prince did.
Does the prince’s mansion have this type of food box? Can you show it to me?”
“Yes, yes!” Fu Kang immediately sent someone to fetch the food boxes.
